_README: Configuration for the split-preserving empirical virtual-node generator
(src/virtual_device_generator.py). JSON rather than YAML for the reason
config/simulated_nodes.json gives: pyyaml is not a dependency of this
project and holding a few dictionaries is not a reason to add one.
WHAT THE GENERATOR PRODUCES. Networks of REAL_DERIVED_VIRTUAL nodes at
n = 2, 3, 5, 10, 15. Each virtual node's base trajectory is a contiguous
block of REAL captured telemetry from the split being built, carrying the
real cross-feature and temporal structure; a persistent per-device scale,
bias, extra noise and drift are applied on top. The nodes are NOT physical
devices, are never described as such, and every row they produce carries
source_type = REAL_DERIVED_VIRTUAL.
THE PARAMETER SPLIT THAT MATTERS. Two categories, kept apart on purpose:
EMPIRICALLY SUPPORTED -- estimated from the real rows of the split being
generated, by src/virtual_device_generator.empirical_stats():
within-session residual covariance   (cross-feature dependence)
per-feature lag-1 autocorrelation     (temporal dependence)
resting centre and per-feature spread
real fault displacement trajectories  (anomaly shape)
CONTROLLED SENSITIVITY -- the numbers in this file. They are NOT learned
from multiple physical units, because this project does not have multiple
physical units to learn them from. esp32-vib-001 is the only device with
completed captures; esp32-vib-002 contributes PENDING_REAL_HARDWARE_DATA
rows only. Nothing derived from these numbers may be described anywhere
as measured device-to-device variation.
Worth stating because it will not improve as much as it looks when the
second board is captured: esp32-vib-002 is an SW-420 vibration SWITCH,
not a second MPU6050 (src/config.py DEVICE_REGISTRY). Completing its
capture gives a second sensing MODALITY, not a second sample of
MPU6050 unit-to-unit spread. Identifying that spread empirically needs
two accelerometers, which the testbed does not have.
WHERE THE MEDIUM PRESET COMES FROM. The closest measured analogue to
device-to-device variation available in this project is BETWEEN-SESSION
variation on the ONE board: resting rms measured 1.041 / 1.056 / 1.011 g on
three occasions (RESULTS.md 0.10.7, ADR-18), a 0.045 g range about a 1.0335
midpoint = +-2.2%, against a within-session sd of ~0.009 g. MEDIUM's
scale_spread is set to that 0.021. It is a PROXY and is labelled one: the
same unit on different days is not two units. LOW and HIGH bracket it by
roughly a factor of two either way so that a conclusion which only holds at
one setting is visible as such (the sensitivity sweep, brief section 13).
bias_sd_multiple and drift_sd_multiple are in units of each feature's OWN
measured spread in the split, so one number applies coherently to rms
(sd ~0.01 g) and dominant_freq (sd ~59 Hz) without either being absurd.
extra_noise_fraction is the fraction of the real residual sd added as
unit-specific measurement variation ON TOP of the real noise already
carried by the base trajectory -- it is an addition, not a replacement,
which is why values above ~0.5 are not offered.

_note: dominant_freq is not continuous. It is a DFT bin index times
all 429 real rows sit exactly on that grid (22 distinct values, every one
a multiple of 15.625 to within its own rounding). A generator that
perturbs it continuously produces values no DFT of this length can emit,
which is a giveaway a discriminator finds immediately and a defect even
if no discriminator were run. Generated values are snapped back to the
grid. Derived from config, not written down, so it follows the rate.
crest_factor = peak / rms EXACTLY in all 429 real rows (verified, not
assumed -- see feature_engineering.crest_factor). It is therefore derived
after every transformation rather than perturbed, which is the brief's
'do not perturb correlated features independently' in its sharpest form:
perturbing all three independently produces readings that violate an
identity the sensor pipeline cannot violate.

_ticks_note: Matched to scripts/generate_network_data.py so a generated network is
comparable in size and event structure to the existing ten-node benchmark
network. block_ticks alternates quiet and event blocks: an event that never
ends is not an event, and event-level metrics need boundaries to count.
